info.title: Task Manager transactional API
info.description: All writes require a unique idempotencyKey; updates require expectedVersion. Identity comes exclusively from the validated Supabase JWT. Claim tokens are private credentials returned only to their executor. A direct human must use intervene_task to complete, move, reassign or delete claimed work. Generic commands and REST aliases share the same SQL authorization.

200.description: Safe workspace identity, name, slug, color, storageVersion and role; direct humans see v1 migration candidates, OAuth requires a normalized grant.

post.description: Deletion is rejected with validation_error if a surviving task would lose a dependency, attachment, or other task relation. Remove such relations explicitly using the surviving task expectedVersion and, for agents, its valid claim token before retrying. Project deletion may remove relations wholly internal to its deleted task set; any active descendant claim must first be explicitly released by human intervention.
